tools.name: document_inspect
tools.description: Inspect PDF, DOCX, legacy DOC, TXT or Markdown metadata and parseability only. This does not return source content and is not enough to summarize a document. For content use pdf_extract_text or docx_extract_structure; scanned PDFs may need pdf_ocr_text.

tools.name: pdf_extract_text
tools.description: Extract bounded PDF text by page while retaining page numbers and optionally write TXT or JSON evidence artifacts.

tools.name: pdf_extract_tables
tools.description: Detect and extract bounded native PDF tables with page and table provenance, writing one CSV per detected table plus a JSON manifest.

tools.name: pdf_render_pages
tools.description: Render explicit or representative PDF pages to bounded PNG images for visual verification of maps, charts, layouts and scanned pages.

tools.name: pdf_find_evidence
tools.description: Find bounded keyword or phrase evidence in a PDF and return page-numbered snippets and match rectangles suitable for citation.

tools.name: pdf_ocr_text
tools.description: OCR explicit or representative pages from a scanned PDF with offline Chinese and English language models, retaining page provenance and optionally writing TXT or JSON artifacts.

tools.name: docx_extract_structure
tools.description: Extract bounded DOCX heading hierarchy, paragraphs, tables, images and document properties while preserving section context.

tools.name: docx_extract_tables
tools.description: Extract DOCX tables to individual CSV artifacts with table index, row and column provenance and a JSON manifest.

tools.name: document_compare
tools.description: Compare two PDF, DOCX, DOC, TXT or Markdown documents using extracted text and return similarity, added and removed evidence chunks.

tools.name: document_visual_validate
tools.description: Validate PDF or Word artifacts by rendering representative pages when possible and checking blank pages, content presence, page dimensions, tables and images.
